answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The falcon multiplier is published, charged in gale, and violet lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 2361 identities would post 4540 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
